test_title: PYST 48: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
'Q × R' means 'Q is the mother of R'

'Q + R' means 'Q is the husband of R'

'Q ÷ R' means 'Q is the daughter of R'

'Q - R' means 'Q is the brother of R'

How is S related to J in the expression 'S × Z - W ÷ J'?
solution:
Family Chart: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cd8ae3409a7e80e7adb6a6adafb5ca1703115230729aa5a03a081d033c62e82.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 ×
 ÷
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 Husband
 Mother
 Daughter
 Brother 
 
 

 

Given: S × Z - W ÷ J

It means: S is the mother of Z, Z is the brother of W and W is the daughter of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17d80de580c5d6863d2129cee79823c2ccccad20e56170ffbe6e44455e927e20.png] 

So, S is the 'Wife' of J.

Hence, the correct answer is "Wife".
